acceptance: A documented option excludes named queries from a run, with the same phase coverage as --queries or a clear error where it does not apply
The TPC-Havoc memory-requirement section uses it instead of the list-everything workaround
Covered by a test on query selection
context:
The owner chose to document the 1_v7 requirement rather than add a skip or scale gate; this item is only about the missing exclude option. Platform skips exist (TPCHavocBenchmark.get_platform_skip_queries, benchbox/validation/bundle.py TPCHAVOC_DOCUMENTED_SKIPS) but are keyed by platform, not scale or user choice. Filed from session review 2026-10-27.

description: BenchBox runs can select queries with --queries (power and standard phases only) but cannot exclude any. The TPC-Havoc documentation therefore tells users who cannot satisfy the 1_v7 memory requirement to list every variant except 1_v7 by hand, which is long for a 22-query, 10-variant benchmark and easy to get wrong.
